","source":"export function slugify(value: string): string {
  return value
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '-');
}

// Ensure that multiple separators are collapsed to a single hyphen
export function slugifyFinal(value: string): string {
  return value
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '-')
    .replace(/-+/g, '-');
}

// Ensure that edge hyphens are removed
export function slugifyEdge(value: string): string {
  return value
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
}

// Final slugify function that combines all rules
export function slugifyFinalFinal(value: string): string {
  return value
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '-')
    .replace(/-+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
}"}
